question: When did the origin of Pūrṇaśaila take place according to this account?
premises: The origin of Pūrṇaśaila is stated.
It occurred at the beginning of the Tretā yuga.
inference: Pūrṇaśaila’s origin is situated at the start of the Tretā age.
plain_english: The origin of Pūrṇaśaila occurred at the beginning of the Tretā yuga.
